reviewer: Codex visual source inspection and PDF character/font inspection; single reviewer

evidence.finding: The leading colon-encoded glyph prints the Hindi ru syllable with a long-u vowel, not punctuation.
The second affected place label uses the same leading colon-encoded long-u ru glyph.

scope: Only the leading colon in GP-name labels from this hash-pinned Etah PDF. Raw fields, reservation codes, row counts, and source identities must be preserved.
unsupported_glyph_policy: No trailing-A mapping is supplied. If a label requires one, the decoder must stop rather than borrow Sitapur's part-marker interpretation.
limitation: Prefix-glyph review only; not certification of whole-name spellings, place identities, historical boundaries, or reservation assignments.
